svg.title: NULL/X — an independent hacker workstation
svg.desc: A paper-beige futuristic Unix desktop with Netscape, AMP playing Break Stuff by Limp Bizkit, Files, xterm, IRC and Packet icons, an analog clock, a Red Hat Linux 6.2 terminal, and the full original The Conscience of a Hacker by The Mentor in vim. The wallpaper reads NO OWNER. NO MASTER. FUCK SOCIETY. HACK THE WORLD. Read the linked text for an accessible copy of the original manifesto.

g.text: The following was written shortly after my arrest...

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: \/\The Conscience of a Hacker/\/

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: by

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: +++The Mentor+++

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Written on January 8, 1986

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Another one got caught today, it's all over the papers. "Teenager

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Arrested in Computer Crime Scandal", "Hacker Arrested after Bank Tampering"...

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Damn kids. They're all alike.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: But did you, in your three-piece psychology and 1950's technobrain,

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: ever take a look behind the eyes of the hacker? Did you ever wonder what

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: made him tick, what forces shaped him, what may have molded him?

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: I am a hacker, enter my world...

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Mine is a world that begins with school... I'm smarter than most of

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: the other kids, this crap they teach us bores me...

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Damn underachiever. They're all alike.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: I'm in junior high or high school. I've listened to teachers explain

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: for the fifteenth time how to reduce a fraction. I understand it. "No, Ms.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Smith, I didn't show my work. I did it in my head..."

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Damn kid. Probably copied it. They're all alike.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: I made a discovery today. I found a computer. Wait a second, this is

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: cool. It does what I want it to. If it makes a mistake, it's because I

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: screwed it up. Not because it doesn't like me...

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Or feels threatened by me...

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Or thinks I'm a smart ass...

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Or doesn't like teaching and shouldn't be here...

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Damn kid. All he does is play games. They're all alike.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: And then it happened... a door opened to a world... rushing through

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: the phone line like heroin through an addict's veins, an electronic pulse is

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: sent out, a refuge from the day-to-day incompetencies is sought... a board is

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: found.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: "This is it... this is where I belong..."

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: I know everyone here... even if I've never met them, never talked to

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: them, may never hear from them again... I know you all...

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Damn kid. Tying up the phone line again. They're all alike...

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: You bet your ass we're all alike... we've been spoon-fed baby food at

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: school when we hungered for steak... the bits of meat that you did let slip

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: through were pre-chewed and tasteless. We've been dominated by sadists, or

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: ignored by the apathetic. The few that had something to teach found us will-

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: ing pupils, but those few are like drops of water in the desert.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: This is our world now... the world of the electron and the switch, the

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: beauty of the baud. We make use of a service already existing without paying

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: for what could be dirt-cheap if it wasn't run by profiteering gluttons, and

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: you call us criminals. We explore... and you call us criminals. We seek

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: after knowledge... and you call us criminals. We exist without skin color,

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: without nationality, without religious bias... and you call us criminals.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: You build atomic bombs, you wage wars, you murder, cheat, and lie to us

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: and try to make us believe it's for our own good, yet we're the criminals.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Yes, I am a criminal. My crime is that of curiosity. My crime is

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: that of judging people by what they say and think, not what they look like.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: My crime is that of outsmarting you, something that you will never forgive me

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: for.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: I am a hacker, and this is my manifesto. You may stop this individual,

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: but you can't stop us all... after all, we're all alike.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: +++The Mentor+++
